Protein–protein interaction (PPI) network and key driver analysis (KDA) of the ECM–receptor interaction pathway

Protein–protein interaction (PPI) network and key driver analysis (KDA) of the ECM–receptor interaction pathway. (A) PPI network showing the interactions between genes in the pathway. (B) Results of the KDA identifying key regulatory genes. Red nodes represent KDA-identified key driver genes, blue nodes denote seed genes, and gray nodes indicate associated genes
